_comment: Temenos Digital DataMigration Fabric app. Paths are appended to the environment's hostUrl + basePath. Payload shapes follow the vendor guide 'Temenos Digital Data Migration and flows' and the vendor Postman collection; open questions are in assumptions.json.

response._comment: Assumption A-10. Failures arrive inside an HTTP 200 body, so HTTP status alone is never success.
